lines.text: و در بعضی بجای فامتحنی فامددنی مذکور است و بجای ابلغ ادراک و بجای درک العلوم
lines.en: And in some [copies], instead of 'fa-imtahinī' (so test me), 'fa-amdidni' (so assist me) is mentioned, and instead of 'ablagh' (reach), 'idrāk' (perception), and instead of 'dark al-ʿulūm' (perception of sciences),

lines.text: بهاء العلوم و بعضی مردم بر این اند که این سه بیت از جمله منظومات باب مدینه علم نبی اعنی
lines.en: 'bahāʾ al-ʿulūm' (splendor of sciences). And some people are of the opinion that these three couplets are among the poems of the Gate of the City of Knowledge of the Prophet, meaning

lines.text: علی ولی علیه السّلام است و چون تصحیح اعراب و الفاظ دعا موافق قانون عربیت از جمله شروط
lines.en: Ali the Guardian, peace be upon him. And since the correction of the vowels and words of the prayer according to the rules of Arabic is among the conditions

lines.text: واجب نمود بیان ان بر سبیل اختصار مجرد از دلیل در حاشیه بر این وجه عطارد بضم دال
lines.en: it seemed necessary to explain it by way of brevity, stripped of evidence, in the margin in this manner: 'ʿUṭārid' with the damma of the unpointed dāl,

lines.text: مهمله ايم الله بفتح همزه و سکون یاء التحتانیه و ضم میم و کسر الهاء من الله طال بفتح طاء مهمله
lines.en: 'aym Allāh' with the fatha of the hamza and the sukun of the yāʾ with two dots below and the damma of the mīm and the kasra of the hāʾ from 'Allāh'. 'Ṭāla' with the fatha of the unpointed ṭāʾ

lines.text: و سکون الف و فتح لام ترقبی بفتح تاء فوقانیه و رای مهمله و ضم قاف مشدده و کسر باء موحده
lines.en: and the sukun of the alif and the fatha of the lām. 'Taraqqubī' with the fatha of the tāʾ with two dots above and the unpointed rāʾ and the damma of the doubled qāf and the kasra of the bāʾ with one dot below

lines.text: و سکون یاء موحده تحتانیه صباحاً بفتح صاد مهمله و باء موحده و سکون الف و فتح خاء
lines.en: and the sukun of the yāʾ with one dot below. 'Ṣabāḥan' with the fatha of the unpointed ṣād and the bāʾ with one dot below and the sukun of the alif and the fatha of the khāʾ

lines.text: مهمله منونه مساءً بفتح میم و سین مهمله و الف ساکنه و همزه مفتوحه منونه کی بفتح کاف
lines.en: unpointed, nunated. 'Masāʾan' with the fatha of the mīm and the unpointed sīn and the quiescent alif and the nunated hamza with fatha. 'Kay' with the fatha of the kāf

lines.text: و سکون یاء تحتانیه اراک بفتح همزه و رای مهمله و الف ساکنه و کاف مفتوحه فاعنّما
lines.en: and the sukun of the yāʾ with two dots below. 'Arāka' with the fatha of the hamza and the unpointed rāʾ and the quiescent alif and the kāf with fatha. 'Fa-aʿinnī-mā'

lines.text: بفتح فا و همزه و سکون عین معجمه و فتح نون و میم و سکون الف اشباع فها بفتح فا انا
lines.en: with the fatha of the fāʾ and the hamza and the sukun of the pointed ʿayn and the fatha of the nūn and the mīm and the sukun of the alif of ishbāʿ. 'Fahā' with the fatha of the fāʾ. 'Anā'

lines.text: بفتح همزه و نون فامتحنی بفتح فا و اسقاط همزه بعد از او در درج و سکون میم و فتح نون
lines.en: with the fatha of the hamza and the nūn. 'Fa-imtahinī' with the fatha of the fāʾ and the dropping of the hamza after it in continuous reading and the sukun of the mīm and the fatha of the nūn

lines.text: و سکون حاء مهمله و کسر نون و سکون یاء تحتانیه قوی بضم قاف و فتح واو منونه ابلغ
lines.en: and the sukun of the unpointed ḥāʾ and the kasra of the nūn and the sukun of the yāʾ with two dots below. 'Quwan' with the damma of the qāf and the fatha of the nunated wāw. 'Ablugh'

lines.text: بفتح همزه و سکون بای موحده و ضم لام و جزم غین معجمه لکن بجهد وصل بما بعد بضم خوانده
lines.en: with the fatha of the hamza and the sukun of the bāʾ with one dot below and the damma of the lām and the jazm of the pointed ghayn, but with the effort of joining with what follows, it is read with damma.

lines.text: میشود المنی مصدر بالام و ضم میم و فتح نون و سکون یاء تحتانیه و درک بفتح واو
lines.en: 'Al-munā' is a verbal noun with al-lām and the damma of the mīm and the fatha of the nūn and the sukun of the yāʾ with two dots below. And 'dark' with the fatha of the wāw

lines.text: عطف و دال و سکون راء مهملتین و فتح کاف العلوم مصدر بالام الغامضات مصدر
lines.en: of conjunction and the dāl and the sukun of the two unpointed rāʾs and the fatha of the kāf. 'Al-ʿulūm' is a verbal noun with al-lām. 'Al-ghāmiḍāt' is a verbal noun

lines.text: بالام و فتح غین معجمه و سکون الف و کسر میم و فتح ضاد معجمه و سکون الف و کسر تاء فوقا
lines.en: with al-lām and the fatha of the pointed ghayn and the sukun of the alif and the kasra of the mīm and the fatha of the pointed ḍād and the sukun of the alif and the kasra of the tāʾ with two dots above.

lines.text: تکرماً بفتح تا و کاف و ضم رای مهمله مشدده مصدر منصوب بر تمیز و ان تکفی بفتح واو
lines.en: 'Takarruman' with the fatha of the tāʾ and the kāf and the damma of the doubled unpointed rāʾ, a verbal noun in the accusative case as specification (tamyīz). And 'an takfī' with the fatha of the wāw

lines.text: عطف و همزه و سکون نون و فتح تاء فوقانیه و سکون کاف و کسر فا و فتح یاء تحتانیه
lines.en: of conjunction and the hamza and the sukun of the nūn and the fatha of the tāʾ with two dots above and the sukun of the kāf and the kasra of the fāʾ and the fatha of the yāʾ with two dots below.

lines.text: و این فعل مؤل بمصدر است و عطف بر کلمه قوی المحظور مصدر بالام و فتح میم و سکون
lines.en: And this verb is interpreted as a verbal noun and is conjoined to the word 'quwan'. 'Al-maḥẓūr' is a verbal noun with al-lām and the fatha of the mīm and the sukun

lines.text: خاء معجمه و ضم ظاء مهمله و الشر بفتح واو عطف و بعد از ان اللام و فتح شین معجمه و راء
lines.en: of the pointed khāʾ and the damma of the unpointed ẓāʾ. And 'al-sharr' with the fatha of the wāw of conjunction and after it al-lām and the fatha of the pointed shīn and the rāʾ

lines.text: مشدده و کله بضم کاف و فتح لام مشدده و ضم ها بامر بکسر بای موحده و فتح همزه
lines.en: doubled. And 'kullahu' with the damma of the kāf and the fatha of the doubled lām and the damma of the hāʾ. 'Bi-amrin' with the kasra of the bāʾ with one dot below and the fatha of the hamza

lines.text: سکون میم و کسر رای مهمله ملیک بفتح میم و کسر لام و سکون یای تحتانیه و کسر کاف منون
lines.en: the sukun of the mīm and the kasra of the unpointed rāʾ. 'Malīkin' with the fatha of the mīm and the kasra of the lām and the sukun of the yāʾ with two dots below and the kasra of the nunated kāf.

lines.text: خالق بفتح خای معجمه و کسر لام و قاف الارض بالام و فتح الف و سکون رای مهمله و کسر
lines.en: 'Khāliq' with the fatha of the pointed khāʾ and the kasra of the lām and the qāf. 'Al-arḍ' with al-lām and the fatha of the alif and the sukun of the unpointed rāʾ and the kasra

sections.en: Meanings of the words of the verses of the prayer of Mercury

summary.headline: Pronunciation of Mercury’s Prayer
summary.text: Variant readings of the prayer of Mercury are compared, including fa-imtahinī/fa-amdidni and ablagh/idrāk/bahāʾ. The passage then supplies Arabic vowel and pronunciation rules for the prayer’s words and attributes some couplets to Ali, the Gate of the City of Knowledge of the Prophet.
